requirements.text: On the Settings screen, the App lock entry appears once as a switch row and there is no separate App lock button.
On the Settings screen, the entries Tax settings, Categories, Export, Backup & restore, View Terms and Privacy Policy are displayed as list rows with a chevron and are not outlined buttons.
On the Settings screen, the Delete all data entry is displayed in the error color, placed last in the list, and separated from the other entries.
All existing features, tests, and screens of the freelance finance tracker must continue to work after the Settings screen changes.
